headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment features to identify potential vulnerabilities in local-first lockfiles, ensuring secure and transparent package installations. Enhance the user interface for better accessibility and ease of use.
actions: Implement a real-time vulnerability scanner that checks for known security issues before installation, providing detailed reports on any risks identified.
